messages:
alex_k: Heads-up — planning the next 3-sprint split for Console visibility. Proposal: ship dashboard template pack (cost, error, latency), tracing-hooks MVP (span-level linking + span tags), and a per-route cost breakdown as a beta. Need choices for scope cuts and launch criteria. Thoughts?

maria_g: Thanks — quick context: two customers (AcmePayments, FinCo) specifically asked for per-route cost visibility + alerts. They consider that blocking their rollout.

jamal_s: From data infra side — we already emit route tags, but aggregation/rollups for cost per route needs a new rollup job and improved sampling. Rough estimate: 2 dev-weeks + 3 days infra config + backfill job if we want historical.

sara_rc: Design POV: dashboard templates are high-leverage. We can deliver useful UX without full per-route rollups by showing "top routes" and a route filter that falls back to raw logs. That keeps initial scope light.

tobi_ops: Operational constraints: recommend perf SLOs for launch — dashboard render p95 < 200ms for common queries; tracing-hooks should add <1% p95 latency to in-flight requests. Also retention for cost metrics should be 90d by default (opt-in longer).

alex_k: OK. Cut proposals if we need to shrink scope: a) ship dashboard templates + tracing-hooks + coarse top-N route breakdown (top 50) as GA; b) per-route detailed breakdown + alerting -> beta in sprint 4; c) postpone A/B/feature-flagging UX to post-GA. Which of these is acceptable?

maria_g: I prefer a variant: keep cut (a) but include alerting for top-10 routes — customers will want proactive notifications.

jamal_s: That sounds doable: once the rollup job exists, we can wire the existing alert infra to top-10 routes in ~3 days (alerts rule + dashboards). The heavy lift is the rollups and backfill. We can stagger: rollup->alerts->full-per-route.

sara_rc: I'll own the dashboard templates + route filter control. ETA: mockups by Thu, interactive prototype by end of sprint 1. Will design placeholders for missing per-route historical data and a clear "beta" banner.

tobi_ops: I'll own SLO verification and the rollout plan (canary windows, observability gates, rollback steps). Suggest canary stages: 2% -> 25% -> 100% across customers. Need a pre-flight checklist for safety.

deploy-bot: Scheduled window suggestion: Wed 10:00-12:00 PST for canary deploy. Tag: #canary-window.

maria_g: :thumbsup: I'll align AcmePayments/FinCo on the plan: top-50 route beta, top-10 alerts, GA once we validate performance and accuracy.

jamal_s: Risk note: rollup compute could spike cost during backfill. Mitigation: sampling on historical backfill, incremental backfill per customer, and budget alarms for rollup jobs. I'll add an instrumentation PR to alert if rollup cost > X.

sara_rc: Quick question — what are our success metrics for launch? Adoption, reduction in support tickets, accuracy of cost calc?

alex_k: Good call. Proposed success metrics: 1) 25% of active Console users open dashboard within first 30 days; 2) <1% error in cost calculations vs ground-truth sampling; 3) <10% support ticket increase for console usage; 4) at least 2 customers in dogfood program verifying alerts.

maria_g: Add one: Time-to-detect (median) for cost anomalies for instrumented routes should improve by 2x for dogfood customers.

tobi_ops: Launch criteria checklist (will post formal doc): 1) Dashboard templates in Console + docs; 2) Tracing-hooks instrumented & validated in staging; 3) Top-10 alerting working end-to-end; 4) Perf SLOs met (render & request latency); 5) Dogfood with 3 customers confirmed; 6) Rollout plan + rollback steps documented.

alex_k: Also add: regression test for cost calc <1% drift (maria_g requested).

maria_g: Yep. I'll coordinate the dogfood customers and write the acceptance test cases.

jamal_s: Action items: I'll open rollup PR by Tue EOD with a benchmark doc. I'll include sampling config and cost budget alarms.

sara_rc: Action: upload mockups Thu and link to figma in the doc.

tobi_ops: Action: draft rollout + rollback playbook and post by EOD today. Will include canary checklist and escalation path.

alex_k: Cool. If anyone hits a blocker, ping me and we'll triage. Thanks all — I'll update the roadmap board and call out the agreed cuts (coarse per-route + top-10 alerts kept).
